_doc: Khuôn Reels (docs/specs/social-reels-templates.md): Ama/Carlos đọc mẫu tiếng Anh ≤150 wpm, chừa lặng cho người xem đọc theo (repeat), IPA lấy từ kho từ lúc dựng, chữ bản địa viết tay (native-qa).

mistake.en: Mixing up l, n and r

segments.text: Light, Night, Right, White. Watch my mouth.
Repeat after me. Light, Night, Right, White.

native.caption: “light”、“night”、“right”和“white”的开头很容易混。l 的舌尖顶住上齿后面，n 要走鼻音，r 的舌头卷起来但不碰上颚。看 Ama 老师的嘴型，在停顿时跟读。更多练习在 Lexkite 应用。

en.hook: Always mixing up l, n and r?
en.caption: The starts of “light”, “night”, “right” and “white” are easy to mix up. For l, the tongue touches behind the top teeth; n uses the nose; for r, the tongue curls but does not touch the top. Watch Ama’s mouth and repeat in the pause. More practice is in the Lexkite app.
